name: pmg-score-with-ice
description: Scores a long list of ideas or experiments with ICE, producing impact, confidence and ease scores, a note on the evidence behind each confidence score, and a shortlist of the top ten to test. Use for "run pmg-score-with-ice", "ICE score these ideas", "pick which experiments to run", "too many growth ideas", "which ideas should we test first", "impact confidence ease", "score our experiment backlog", part of The Complete Claude Guide for Product Managers Pack by 90n.
